access.meaning: Raw OSM access tag when present

bridge.meaning: Raw OSM bridge tag when present

geometry.meaning: Source linestring, or a two-point line from node coordinates

lanes.meaning: Raw OSM lanes tag; missing values stay missing

layer.meaning: Raw OSM layer tag when present

length.meaning: Edge length from the OSM geometry

maxspeed.meaning: Raw OSM maxspeed tag; missing or compound values are not imputed

osmid.meaning: OpenStreetMap way identifier copied from the dated extract

stage3_arc_id.meaning: SHA-256 of canonical u, v, key, osmid, and geometry identity

stage3_explicit_speed_kph.meaning: Parsed unambiguous maxspeed in kilometres per hour, else missing

stage3_free_flow_time_seconds.meaning: length / explicit speed; missing when speed or length is unavailable

tunnel.meaning: Raw OSM tunnel tag when present
